complexity.notes: Unnecessarily re-sorts an input that is already sorted, adding an O(n log n) factor and O(n) extra space, which also violates the problem's O(1) space requirement. The nums.index() fallback scans are each O(n) and the pop-based duplicate handling is convoluted; a plain two-pointer sweep on the original array would be O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array, then uses a two-pointer sweep to find the pair summing to target, and finally recovers the original 1-indexed positions via linear index() searches.
